body: As the train door opens, I slip out into the quiet station, my eyes scanning for any sign of movement. The dark windows seem to swallow the last remnants of the night, and the air is heavy with an eerie stillness. I take a deep breath, feeling the chill seep into my bones, and quickly move towards the platform's edge. I push off and sprint across the empty platform, my feet pounding against the cold metal. The station's exits are dimly lit, but I can hear the distant hum of footsteps, growing fainter with each step.
